verdict.rationale: Fathom documents only an official MCP server that exposes its meeting data to external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Fathom's own assistant connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
